## Checklist / 自查

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, unit tests, audits, CSS chunks, dist, size budgets)
- [ ] Browser suite for the touched area passes (see `packages/react/AGENTS.md`), or N/A
- [ ] `npm run guard` passes
- [ ] Public API changes are reflected in `src/catalog.ts`, docs, the medium example and `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Visual changes: screenshots attached (light, dark, 390px mobile)
- [ ] No breaking change, or a migration note is in `CHANGELOG.md`
